title: Singaporeans Swamp Orchard Road as AP × Swatch Hits S$10,000 on Carousell
summary: Long queues formed at Singapore Swatch stores as fans rushed to snap up the Audemars Piguet × Swatch Royal Pop collection. Despite a strict one-per-person limit, resellers wasted no time listing the S$535–570 watches on Carousell for up to S$10,000 — a nearly 20× markup.

title: Long Queues at ION Orchard & Marina Bay Sands Ahead of Royal Pop Launch
summary: Hopeful buyers camped overnight outside ION Orchard and Marina Bay Sands Swatch boutiques before the Royal Pop drop, with queues stretching hundreds of people by dawn. Staff issued queue tickets from early morning to manage the crowd, with some customers arriving the previous evening.

title: VivoCity Swatch Store NOT Selling Royal Pop — Don't Queue There
summary: Mothership confirmed that the Swatch store at VivoCity is not participating in the Royal Pop drop, after confused shoppers were spotted queuing there. Only ION Orchard and Marina Bay Sands are authorised Royal Pop launch locations in Singapore.

title: Hongkongers Queue Round the Clock for AP × Swatch Royal Pop
summary: Fans in Hong Kong lined up for days outside Swatch boutiques for the Royal Pop, a collection of eight Bioceramic pocket watches priced at HK$2,940–HK$3,150. The watches offer a rare affordable entry point into Audemars Piguet's world, whose timepieces typically cost hundreds of thousands of dollars.

title: Everything You Need to Know About the AP × Swatch Royal Pop in Singapore
summary: CNA Lifestyle breaks down the full Royal Pop collection: eight Bioceramic Royal Oak-inspired designs, Singapore pricing at S$535–570, launch locations at ION Orchard and Marina Bay Sands, and the one-watch-per-person-per-day purchase rule. The piece also covers why demand has been so intense and what to expect if you're planning to queue.

title: Audemars Piguet × Swatch Royal Pop Collection Launches Worldwide
summary: Swatch and Audemars Piguet unveiled the Royal Pop, a collection of eight colourful Bioceramic pocket watches reinterpreting the iconic Royal Oak design through a Pop Art lens. Priced at S$535–570 in Singapore, the watches launched on May 16, 2026 with a strict one-per-person-per-day policy. Audemars Piguet is donating 100% of its proceeds to support the next generation of watchmaking talent.

title: Swatch Launches AI-DADA: OpenAI-Powered Custom Watch Design Tool
summary: Swatch introduced AI-DADA, an OpenAI-powered personalization tool that lets customers design one-of-a-kind watches using simple text prompts. Drawing on 40+ years of Swatch's design archive, the tool generates a unique New Gent timepiece — each marked "1/1" on its caseback — priced at CHF 170 (around $210).

title: Swatch Releases SCUBAQUA Dive Watch Collection
summary: Swatch launched the SCUBAQUA collection on May 8, 2025, featuring five jellyfish-inspired dive watches made from a fusion of Bioceramic and biosourced materials derived from castor oil. The 44mm watches offer 10-bar water resistance and are priced at USD $150, with two models incorporating Swatch Pay contactless payment technology.

title: MoonSwatch Mission to the Pink Moonphase Drops for Limited Time
summary: Omega × Swatch released the Mission to the Pink Moonphase as a limited-time offering starting April 1, 2025, at selected Swatch stores worldwide. The release continues the MoonSwatch Moonphase sub-line, blending Speedmaster-inspired design with a moonphase complication in vivid Bioceramic colours.

title: Omega × Swatch Expands MoonSwatch with Mission to Earthphase Moonshine Gold
summary: Omega and Swatch debuted the Mission to Earthphase Moonshine Gold series, adding an Earth phase complication that shows how Earth appears from the Moon. Each monthly edition features a Snoopy detail tied to that month's full moon, crafted in Omega's Moonshine Gold colourway.

title: Blancpain × Swatch Bioceramic Scuba Fifty Fathoms "Ocean of Storms" Unveiled
summary: Swatch and Blancpain launched the "Ocean of Storms" edition of their Bioceramic Scuba Fifty Fathoms collaboration, with a black colorway inspired by the lunar mare Oceanus Procellarum. Priced at USD $400, the watch uses Swatch's SISTEM51 mechanical movement and features a NATO strap made from recycled fishing nets.

title: MoonSwatch Mission to the Super Blue Moonphase: Limited August 2024 Drop
summary: Swatch and Omega offered the Mission to the Super Blue Moonphase for a brief window from August 1 to August 19, 2024, at selected Swatch points of sale worldwide. The watch commemorated the rare Super Blue Moon and continued the MoonSwatch tradition of timed, event-linked limited releases.
